meta.description:
Eyeva – The Ultimate BigCommerce Theme for Seamless Shopping & Customization.
Designed for modern eCommerce stores, Eyeva delivers a feature-rich, visually stunning, and high-performing shopping experience. Packed with innovative functionalities, this theme empowers you to create a conversion-optimized and user-friendly store with no coding required.

Standout Features

Drag & Drop Mega Menu Builder
Easily craft custom mega menus with banners, widgets, and rich content using the intuitive Page Builder, offering effortless navigation.

Advanced Wishlists – No Login Required
Let customers save their favorite products without an account and access their wishlist instantly in a sleek quick-view modal.

Enhanced Cart Drawer for Seamless Shopping
A modern, accessible cart drawer that allows customers to manage their cart without leaving the current page.

Recently Viewed Products Anywhere
Automatically display recently viewed items on any page, including the cart drawer, helping customers revisit products with ease.

Smart Cart Suggestions
Boost upsells with automated related product recommendations inside the cart drawer and cart page.

360° Product Image Viewer
Enhance product visibility with an interactive 360-degree view, available on product cards and detail pages.

Conditional Product Modifiers
Dynamically adjust product options, prices, and tooltips based on user selections for a truly customizable experience.

Stepper Functionality for Product Options
Present product options in a step-by-step format, making customization intuitive and structured.

Countdown Timer for Sales
Create urgency with a live countdown timer on product pages and listings, boosting conversions.

Countdown Timer for Shipping
Encourage faster purchases by displaying estimated shipping deadlines on product pages.

Advanced Faceted Filtering with Thumbnails & Colors
Enhance product discovery with visual filters, including thumbnail previews and color swatches.

Optimized Mobile Faceted Filters
Ensure a smooth and user-friendly filtering experience on all devices with a mobile-first design.

Mobile-Optimized Add to Cart Experience
A refined mobile-friendly add-to-cart interface for effortless checkout and better usability.

Quick & Easy Product Option Editing
Modify product selections on-the-fly without needing to reload the page.

Streamlined Multi-Step Sign-Up Form
Simplify user registration with a clean, multi-step form for better engagement.

Redesigned Customer Account Pages
An intuitive, fresh layout for all customer account pages, enhancing user experience and account management.

With Eyeva, your store is not just another eCommerce site – it's a high-performance, feature-packed shopping experience that keeps customers engaged and coming back for more.

meta.description:
Eyeva Sofas - The Ultimate BigCommerce Theme for Exceptional Furniture Shopping.
Created for contemporary furniture and home decor retailers, Eyeva Sofas turns your catalog of sofas, tables, and bedroom sets into a visually rich, lightning fast shopping journey. Every pixel is tuned for conversion and ease of use - no coding needed.

Furniture-Focused Standout Features

Drag-and-Drop Mega Menu Builder
Showcase full room collections (Living Room, Bedroom, Outdoor, Decor) with banners, icons, and inspiration images using the intuitive Page Builder.

Advanced Wishlists - No Login Required
Let shoppers save dream sofas or dining sets without an account and access them instantly in a sleek quick view modal.

Enhanced Cart Drawer for Seamless Shopping
A modern slide out drawer where customers can edit quantities, upholstery options, and finishes without leaving the current page.

Recently Viewed Products Anywhere
Automatically surface the last browsed armchairs or coffee tables on any page, including the cart drawer, to rekindle interest.

Smart Cart Suggestions
Increase average order value with automated Complete the Room recommendations inside the cart drawer and on the cart page.

360-Degree Product Image Viewer
Let customers spin sofas, sideboards, or lamps for a full 360 degree inspection on product cards and detail pages.

Conditional Product Modifiers
Dynamically update fabric swatches, wood finishes, pricing, and tooltips based on customer selections for a truly custom piece.

Stepper Product Customization
Guide shoppers through size, fabric, leg style, and add on choices in a clear step by step flow.

Countdown Timer for Sales
Create urgency on clearance couches or limited edition decor with a live countdown.

Countdown Timer for Shipping
Show real time cutoffs like 'Order in the next 02:15:32 for dispatch today' to speed up decisions.

Advanced Faceted Filtering with Thumbnails and Color Swatches
Help buyers narrow by material, seat capacity, wood tone, or fabric hue with image driven filters.

Optimized Mobile Faceted Filters
A mobile first filter drawer ensures effortless discovery on phones and tablets.

Mobile-Optimized Add to Cart
Thumb friendly controls speed up checkout for on the go shoppers.

Quick and Easy Product Option Editing
Change fabric or size selections on the fly without reloading the page.

Sleek Multi-Step Sign-Up Form
Capture new accounts with a streamlined, low friction registration flow.

Redesigned Customer Account Pages
A fresh, furniture branded dashboard makes managing orders, returns, and wishlists intuitive.

With Eyeva Sofas, your furniture store becomes more than a catalog - it is an immersive, feature packed destination that delights visitors and keeps them coming back.

Eyeva Laptops - The Ultimate BigCommerce Theme for Laptop & Tech Retailers.
Specifically designed for laptop, computer, and technology stores, Eyeva Laptops delivers a modern, fast, and professional shopping experience. Every feature is optimized to boost conversion rates and ease of use - no coding required.

Laptop-Focused Standout Features

Drag & Drop Mega Menu Builder
Create custom mega menus showcasing Gaming, Business, Graphics, and Accessories categories using the intuitive Page Builder.

Advanced Wishlists - No Login Required
Let customers save their favorite laptops without an account and access them instantly in a sleek quick-view modal.

Enhanced Cart Drawer for Seamless Shopping
A modern slide-out drawer where customers can edit configurations, RAM, storage without leaving the current page.

Recently Viewed Products Anywhere
Automatically display recently browsed laptops on any page, including the cart drawer, to rekindle interest.

Smart Cart Suggestions
Increase order value with intelligent accessory recommendations like mice, keyboards, and laptop bags in the cart drawer.

360° Product Image Viewer
Let customers rotate laptops 360 degrees to view from every angle on product cards and detail pages.

Conditional Product Modifiers
Dynamically update RAM, SSD, graphics cards, pricing, and tooltips based on customer selections.

Stepper Product Customization
Guide customers through configuration choices step-by-step: Processor → RAM → Storage → Graphics.

Advanced PC Builder Tool
Revolutionary custom PC builder allowing customers to select compatible components (CPU, motherboard, RAM, graphics card, storage) with real-time compatibility checking, price updates, and build summary. Perfect for gaming rigs and workstations.

Countdown Timer for Sales
Create urgency for laptop flash sales with live countdown timers.

Countdown Timer for Shipping
Display shipping deadlines like 'Order within 02:15:32 to receive today' to speed decisions.

Advanced Faceted Filtering with Visual Elements
Filter by brand, CPU, RAM, GPU, price with visual thumbnails and color swatches for an intuitive search experience.

Optimized Mobile Faceted Filters
Mobile-first filter design ensures smooth search experience on smartphones and tablets.

Mobile-Optimized Add to Cart Experience
Streamlined mobile add-to-cart interface for effortless checkout on any device.

Quick Product Option Editing
Modify laptop configurations instantly without page reloads for a seamless experience.

Multi-Step Sign-Up Form
Simplified multi-step registration form that increases completion rates.

Redesigned Customer Account Pages
Professional new customer account interface for managing orders, warranties, and tech support.

With Eyeva Laptops, your tech store isn't just a catalog - it's a comprehensive, feature-rich destination that engages customers and drives them to return.
